answer: Bond of 500 POA per identity, locked 30 epochs, released only after 3 unrelated confirmations. Auditors rotate from a pool of 40 each epoch. For 1,000 identities the attacker locks 500,000 POA and holds it 30 epochs before earning. A bond from one subnet weighs 0.5, and a bridge between two bonded identities counts as one confirmation, never two. Volume at the jetty buys nothing when cost is linear in identities, and the atlas of bonds shows every cluster above three linked accounts.
